visual.general_description: Close-up color photograph of a small, brown-toned genital region held between the gloved fingers of an examiner, with a small ridge-like fold of skin near the tip.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph. Two pale blue-white gloved fingers enter from the upper left and lower left and hold a rounded, brown-toned tissue structure at the centre-right, with a crease or slit-like opening near its right end and a few skin folds along its upper edge. A tip of another skin-colored finger is visible at the right edge, and brown skin fills the upper right corner. The area around the opening shows a slightly lighter pinkish rim. No separate stone, bead or whitish particle can be distinguished at this resolution. No text, arrows, scale bar, panel letters, face or other identifying marks are visible.
